Build a Stale-Answer Detector for AI Applications
THEME: AI Agents & Intelligent Systems
Build an AI-powered verification system that identifies outdated information in LLM-generated answers. The system should detect potentially stale claims involving pricing, API versions, regulations, or company information, re-verify them against live web sources, and provide a freshness score for each claim.

The solution should help users distinguish current, reliable information from potentially outdated AI-generated responses using both Tavily and Bifrost.
